1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 Be7 4.Bc4 Bh4+ 5.strategy: Castles into the open lines instead of recovering a pawn, so that the rook reaches the f-file. The pawn on h2 hangs with check, so White is ready to give up a third pawn for activity, the kind of wild gamble the line is known for.
Takes the third pawn with check. Black is three pawns up, but White's pieces are ready to use the open files, so Black has to consolidate carefully and be ready to give material back.
